SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-16-2018 - CONTINUED ON COURT'S OWN MOTION TO APR-09-2019 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GARY LADAY ADAMS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT THE GEO GROUP IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY MARIA RICHARD, DIRECTOR. THE COURT HAS CONTINUED THE CASE FOR UPDATES ABOUT THE STATUS OF THE FBI INVESTIGATION AND THE FBI'S IMPOUNDMENT OF PLAINTIFF'S MONEY. DEFENDANT NEED NOT APPEAR BUT SHALL SUBMIT A DECLARATION IN ADVANCE OF THE HEARING IF THE DEFENDANT HAS UPDATES ABOUT STATUS. IF PLAINTIFF DOES NOT APPEAR THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE ON COURT'S OWN MOTION. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.
THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE PER 10-16-18 ORDER. NO APPEARANCES. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: J. BERTELSEN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
